remarks.after:
## Remarks

The triangle displays reassociation through the common set of triples. Write $L=(M\otimes_RN)\otimes_SP$, $T=M\otimes_R(N\otimes_SP)$, and $\alpha=\alpha_{M,N,P}$. The set maps are $q_L(m,n,p)=(m\otimes n)\otimes p$ and $q_T(m,n,p)=m\otimes(n\otimes p)$.

```tikzcd
\begin{tikzcd}[column sep=large, row sep=large, font=\large]
M\times N\times P \arrow[d, "q_L"'] \arrow[dr, "q_T"] & \\
(M\otimes_RN)\otimes_SP \arrow[r, shift left=1, "\alpha"] & M\otimes_R(N\otimes_SP) \arrow[l, shift left=1, "\beta"]
\end{tikzcd}

## Remarks

The five-term diagram used in step 1.1 makes the five-lemma application visible. Write $D^k(X)=H^k_{\mathrm{dR}}(X)$, $S^k(X)=H_\infty^k(X;\mathbb R)$, $D^k(U,V)=D^k(U)\oplus D^k(V)$ and $S^k(U,V)=S^k(U)\oplus S^k(V)$. Here $W=U\cap V$, and $I_{U,V}=I_U\oplus I_V$ in the indicated degree.

```tikzcd
D^{q-1}(U,V) \arrow[r,"s_D"] \arrow[d,"I_{U,V}"'] & D^{q-1}(W) \arrow[r,"\Delta_D"] \arrow[d,"I_W"] & D^q(M) \arrow[r,"r_D"] \arrow[d,"I_M"] & D^q(U,V) \arrow[r,"s_D"] \arrow[d,"I_{U,V}"] & D^q(W) \arrow[d,"I_W"] \\
